lines.zh: 我悬在花前，翅膀快得只剩影子。
lines.en: I hover at a flower, wings a blur.

lines.zh: 我不停在一处，总是往后一退。
lines.en: I never stay put; I always back off.

lines.zh: 我从这朵花移到那朵花。
lines.en: I move from this flower to that one.
I fly at night and hide by day.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀是透明的，看得见后面的花。
lines.en: My wings are clear; you see the flower through them.

lines.zh: 我像蜂鸟一样停在空中。
lines.en: I hang in the air like a hummingbird.
I quiver my wings and aim at the bloom.

lines.zh: 我一退一进，像在缝东西。
lines.en: I dart back and forth as if sewing.

lines.zh: 我从平原飞到雪线边上。
lines.en: I fly from the plains to the edge of the snow.
My body is only a little stub.
I circle a white tulip.
I fly low over the grass tips.
My shadow wavers on the flowers.

lines.zh: 我飞到叶子上方，停了一下。
lines.en: I fly above a leaf and pause.
I miss a flower and go back.
I head the way you are going.
I hover, wings humming.
My proboscis is coiled.
I stop before a flower.
The night air is cool.
I am always moving.
I tilt to avoid the wind.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀几乎没有颜色。
lines.en: My wings have almost no color.
I am looking for white flowers.

lines.zh: 我落到花瓣上，立刻又起来。
lines.en: I touch the petal and lift off at once.
I hear water in the distance.
I rest on a blade of grass.
I catch the scent of flowers again.

lines.zh: 你站着不动，我绕你飞了一圈。
lines.en: You stand still, so I circle you once.
You are much bigger than a flower.
I pause in front of you.
Do not swat at me.
My wings are pitifully thin.
I back off half a block.
I only come out at night.
Can you make out my wings?
I am about to go.
I fly crookedly.
A patch of scales falls off.
A corner is missing from my wing.
My proboscis coils back.
I fly a little lower.
I can still fly.
I keep my distance.
My lifespan was short to begin with.
A white tulip; I see it.
I fly toward your hand.
I will take one sip and go.
This flower is good.
I recognize only white ones.
I hover above the petals.
I nibble a corner off the flower.
Hold it steady.

lines.zh: 我撞在你手上，翅膀一乱。
lines.en: I hit your hand and my wings falter.
I retreat at once.

lines.zh: 夜里悬停，我撞上你的网。
lines.en: Hovering at night, I hit your net.
I tumble once, then steady.
You are between me and my flower.
I go around you.
A few scales drift off me.
I skim past you.
I nearly drop to the ground.
I rise again.
There is another moth in the night.

lines.zh: 我们一起悬在同一朵花上。
lines.en: We hover at the same flower.
Two pairs of wings hum together.
We fly in small circles.
It backs off and I follow.
I leave eggs on a leaf.
The leaf will look after them.
I find a shaded spot.
I land on what fell.
I grasp at it with my forelegs.
I try once and give up.
I hover beside it.
I can carry a small flake.
I set it on a leaf.
What you dropped is over there.
I look once more.
I knock it over as I leave.
You mean to hurt me?
I can only fly away.
I retreat behind a flower.
My wings are trembling.
I fly toward the trees.
Do not swing your hand.
I am so small.
I do not want to be caught.
I back away behind the white tulips.
I circle around you.
My flight is erratic.
You will not catch me.
I return to the flower.
I hide behind a leaf.
My wings grow quieter.
I climb a little.
Your hands are too slow.
I am still watching that flower.
I will go soon.
I bump into your hand.
I have no strength.
I beat my wings at you.
Your finger twitches back.
I must go.
I lift a little.
I jab the back of your hand with my beak.
One beat of these wings is enough for you.

lines.zh: 我从茧里钻出来，翅膀还是湿的。
lines.en: I climb out of the cocoon with wet wings.
The night wind lifts me.
I hover for the first time.
There are white flowers on the plains.
I am by the snowline too.
My wings slowly turn clear.
I smell flowers for the first time.

lines.zh: 我的手不够长，只能靠近。
lines.en: My reach is short, so I must come close.
I take off from a leaf.
My lifespan begins counting down.
I fall to the ground and scrabble.

lines.zh: 水糊住我的翅膀，我扇不动。
lines.en: Water mats my wings and I cannot beat them.
The blast sweeps me far away.

lines.zh: 光一亮，我什么都看不见。
lines.en: A flash of light and I see nothing.
My strength is nearly spent.

lines.zh: 雷光把夜照白，我撞在叶上。
lines.en: Lightning whitens the night and I hit a leaf.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有花，也没有风。
lines.en: No flowers and no wind in the void.
